name: Gabby's The Junction (Dundas West)
description: Part of Gabby's Kitchen + Bar, a family-owned GTA sports bar and casual restaurant chain since 1989, known for award-winning wings, hand-battered fish & chips, and made-to-order chicken tenders. This location is listed as accepting reservations, but the site's online booking link is currently broken (redirects to the homepage) — call ahead to reserve. Also hosts weekly karaoke (Fri) and trivia (Thu) nights.
